name: Rumble
title: the Mechanized Menace

Q.name: Flamespitter
Q.description: Rumble ignites his flamethrower, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 + 1.05×AP plus 6/6.5/7.0/7.5/8% max Health magic damage over 3 seconds, reduced to 70% against minions. Danger Zone: Damage is increased to (50/75/100/125/150 + 1.05×AP) × 1.5 plus (0.06/0.065/0.07/0.075/0.08) × 1.5 max Health. Percent damage is limited to 65–300 (by level) damage on Monsters.
Q.summary: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

W.name: Scrap Shield
W.description: Rumble tosses up a barrier, gaining 25/55/85/115/145 + 0.3×AP + 0.04×max HP Shield for (varies) seconds and 10/15/20/25/30% Move Speed for 1 second. Danger Zone: The barrier grants (25/55/85/115/145 + 0.3×AP + 0.04×max HP) × 1.5 Shield and (0.1/0.15/0.2/0.25/0.3) × 1.5 Move Speed instead.
W.summary: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

E.name: Electro Harpoon
E.description: Rumble launches an electrified harpoon, dealing 55/80/105/130/155 + 0.5×AP magic damage, Slowing by 15/20/25/30/35% for 2 seconds, and reducing the enemy's Magic Resist by 10/12/14.0/16/18% for 4 seconds. Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to 30/40/50/60/70% and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by 20/24/28.0/32/36% Danger Zone: The harpoon deals (55/80/105/130/155 + 0.5×AP) × 1.5 magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.
E.summary: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

R.name: The Equalizer
R.description: Rumble launches a line of rockets, creating a burning trail that lasts 4.5 seconds, Slowing by 35% and dealing 120/200/280 + 0.4×AP magic damage per second. Rumble can control the direction of the trail by clicking and dragging while casting this Ability.
R.summary: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

Passive.name: Junkyard Titan
Passive.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.
Passive.summary: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Mech-piloting mage who manages Heat: abilities raise it, and at 50+ Heat they get stronger. Wins lane with Q flamethrower in short range and wins fights with the R equalizer.
strengths: Q flamethrower deals high damage over time at short range
W shield blocks poke and gives move speed
R zone deals heavy damage and slows across a teamfight
No mana; Heat manages his resource
weaknesses: Overheat (100 Heat) silences him, opening a window
Short range: kited by ranged champions
No dash; vulnerable to ganks without W
profile.curveNote: Wants Q, W and E to trade and manage Heat in the danger zone.

Passive.notes: Heat: 50+ Danger Zone empowers; 100 overheats, silences, attacks deal bonus damage.

R.notes: Line of fire zone that slows and burns.

profile.windowAgainst: Overheated (silenced) or W down; Q on cooldown.
checks: Whether E harpoons are blockable missiles (I set yes).
